# Pages JavaScript API

Everything the [Pages](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/pages) extension adds to `pb_hooks` and page code, generated from the TypeScript declarations it ships (your app's `types.d.ts` has the same, so your editor knows them). For how to use it, see its docs; for Go, the [Go API](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go).

## Types

### pages.Data

What `ctx.data` holds: shared by middleware, handlers and templates. Add your own keys by redeclaring it.

### pages.Params

Route parameters (`[id]` in a path), strings. Never includes query parameters.

### pages.CookieOptions

Options for `ctx.res.cookie` and `ctx.res.clearCookie`.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `path?` | `string` |  |
| `domain?` | `string` |  |
| `maxAge?` | `number` | Seconds. |
| `expires?` | `Date \| number \| string` | A Date, milliseconds since the epoch, or a date string. |
| `httpOnly?` | `boolean` | Default true. |
| `secure?` | `boolean` | Default: true on HTTPS. |
| `sameSite?` | `"Lax" \| "Strict" \| "None" \| "lax" \| "strict" \| "none"` | Default "Lax". |

### pages.Request

`ctx.req`: the request.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `readonly method` | `string` | `"GET"`, `"POST"`, ... |
| `readonly url` | `{ href: string; origin: string; pathname: string; search: string }` |  |
| `query()` | `(): { [name: string]: string }` | Every query parameter's first value. |
| `query()` | `(name: string, opts: { all: true }): string[]` | Every value of a query parameter. |
| `query()` | `(name: string, opts?: { all?: false }): string \| undefined` | A query parameter's first value, or `undefined`. |
| `header()` | `(name: string): string` | A request header, `''` if absent. |
| `cookie()` | `(name: string, opts: { json: true }): T \| undefined` | A cookie parsed as JSON (`undefined` if absent or not JSON). |
| `cookie()` | `(name: string, opts?: { json?: false }): string \| undefined` | A cookie's value, or `undefined`. |
| `cookies()` | `(): { [name: string]: string }` |  |
| `body()` | `(): T` | The parsed body: a JSON value, or form fields as `{ name: value }` (repeated names as arrays). |
| `files()` | `(name: string): filesystem.File[]` | Uploaded files of a multipart field, ready for a record's file field. |
| `readonly ip` | `string` | The client's IP, as PocketBase resolves it. |
| `readonly event` | `core.RequestEvent` | The underlying PocketBase request event, for anything not covered here. |

### pages.EventStream

What `ctx.res.sse()` returns.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `send()` | `(event: string, data: any, opts?: { id?: string \| number; retry?: number }): void` | Sends an event; non-string data is JSON-encoded. |
| `comment()` | `(text: string): void` | Writes an SSE comment (`: text`), which browsers ignore. |
| `close()` | `(): void` |  |

### pages.Response

`ctx.res`: the response. Every method that sends ends the request (later steps are skipped).

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `status()` | `(code: number): Response` | The status for the rendered page. |
| `header()` | `(name: string): string` | Reads a response header back. |
| `header()` | `(name: string, value: string \| number): Response` | Sets a response header. |
| `cookie()` | `(name: string, value: any, opts?: CookieOptions): Response` | Sets a cookie; a non-string value is JSON-encoded. |
| `clearCookie()` | `(name: string, opts?: Pick<CookieOptions, "path" \| "domain">): Response` | Expires a cookie (same `path`/`domain` as when it was set). |
| `redirect()` | `(location: string, opts?: number \| { status?: number; flash?: any }): Response` | Sends a redirect (3xx, default 302). `flash` sets a one-time message the next request reads with `ctx.flash()`. |
| `json()` | `(data: any): Response` |  |
| `json()` | `(status: number, data: any): Response` |  |
| `html()` | `(html: string): Response` | HTML as-is, without layouts. |
| `html()` | `(status: number, html: string): Response` |  |
| `text()` | `(text: string): Response` |  |
| `text()` | `(status: number, text: string): Response` |  |
| `file()` | `(path: string): Response` | Sends a file from pb_pages (path relative to pb_pages). |
| `sse()` | `(opts?: { keepAlive?: number }): EventStream` | Starts a `text/event-stream` response. `keepAlive` (seconds) writes a comment that often while the handler runs, so proxies keep a quiet stream open. |
| `layout()` | `(on: boolean): Response` | `layout(false)` renders this page without layouts (e.g. an htmx fragment). |
| `readonly sent` | `boolean` | True once a response has been sent. |

### pages.Session

`ctx.session`: cookie sessions on PocketBase auth. Present when the `auth` plugin is on.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `authMethods()` | `(opts?: { collection?: string }): { password: { enabled: boolean; identityFields: string[] }; otp: { enabled: boolean }; mfa: { enabled: boolean }; oauth2: { enabled: boolean; providers: { name: string; displayName: string }[] }; }` |  |
| `register()` | `(email: string, password: string, opts?: { collection?: string; data?: { [field: string]: any }; verify?: boolean; signIn?: boolean }): SignedIn` | Creates the record; sends the verification email when `verify`; signs in when `signIn` (else `token` is `''`). |
| `signInWithPassword()` | `(identity: string, password: string, opts?: { collection?: string }): SignedIn` |  |
| `requestOTP()` | `(email: string, opts?: { collection?: string; create?: boolean }): string` | Always returns an id (unknown emails get one that never validates). |
| `signInWithOTP()` | `(otpId: string, code: string, opts?: { collection?: string }): SignedIn` |  |
| `signInAnonymously()` | `(opts?: { collection?: string }): SignedIn` |  |
| `requestOAuth2()` | `(provider: string, opts?: { collection?: string; redirectPath?: string; redirect?: boolean }): string` | Returns the provider's URL; with `redirect` (default) it also sends the redirect. |
| `signInWithOAuth2()` | `(state: string, code: string, opts?: { createData?: { [field: string]: any } }): SignedIn & { meta: { isNew: boolean; [key: string]: any } }` |  |
| `signIn()` | `(record: core.Record): SignedIn` | Sets the session cookie for a record the app authenticated itself. |
| `signOut()` | `(): void` |  |
| `requestVerification()` | `(email: string, opts?: { collection?: string }): void` |  |
| `confirmVerification()` | `(token: string): void` |  |
| `requestPasswordReset()` | `(email: string, opts?: { collection?: string }): void` |  |
| `confirmPasswordReset()` | `(token: string, password: string, passwordConfirm: string): void` |  |
| `requestEmailChange()` | `(newEmail: string): void` | Needs `ctx.auth`. |
| `confirmEmailChange()` | `(token: string, password: string): void` |  |

### pages.Realtime

`ctx.realtime`: PocketBase realtime from page code. Present when the `realtime` plugin is on.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `send()` | `(topic: string, data: any, opts?: { filter?: (client: subscriptions.Client) => boolean }): void` | Sends to every client subscribed to `topic` (`filter` only narrows that set). `data` is always JSON-encoded. |
| `client()` | `(id: string): subscriptions.Client \| null` | One client by id, or `null`. |
| `subscribe()` | `(topic: string, opts?: { filter?: string; expand?: string; fields?: string }): RealtimeSubscription<T>` | Listens to `topic` like a browser on `/api/realtime`, as this visitor: the collection's list/view rules apply, and `filter`, `expand` and `fields` work as in the JS SDK's subscribe options. Read it with `for await`. Record topics (`posts/*`, `posts/RECORD_ID`) give `{ action, record }`; other topics give the data sent to them. It ends when the request does, on `close()`, or (throwing) if the page falls 64 messages behind. |

### pages.RealtimeRecordMessage

A record change from `ctx.realtime.subscribe()`.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `action` | `"create" \| "update" \| "delete"` |  |
| `record` | `{ [field: string]: any }` |  |

### pages.RealtimeSubscription

What `ctx.realtime.subscribe()` returns.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `close()` | `(): void` | Ends the subscription; a waiting `for await` finishes. |

### pages.Context

The request context, passed to middleware, handlers, templates, components and plugins.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `req` | `Request` |  |
| `res` | `Response` |  |
| `data` | `Data` |  |
| `params` | `Params` |  |
| `route` | `Route` |  |
| `auth` | `core.Record \| null` | The authenticated record, or `null`. |
| `app` | `PocketBase` | The app (`$app`). |
| `dev` | `boolean` | True in dev mode. |
| `readonly pagesDir` | `string` | The absolute path of this app's pb_pages folder. |
| `env()` | `(name: string): string` | An environment variable, `''` if unset. |
| `log` | `Log` |  |
| `meta()` | `(key: string): any` | Reads a page metadata value (title, description). |
| `meta()` | `(key: string, value: T): T` | Sets a page metadata value; returns it. |
| `asset()` | `(path: string): string` | URL of a static file in pb_pages with its content hash: `/assets/app.3f9a1c2b7d4e.css`. |
| `include()` | `(name: string, locals?: { [key: string]: any }): any` | Renders a `_private/` partial and returns its text (a promise when the partial is async). |
| `resolve()` | `(name: string, opts?: { mode?: "require" }): T` | Loads a module's exports from `_private/`. |
| `resolve()` | `(name: string, opts: { mode: "raw" \| "script" \| "style" }): string` | Reads a `_private/` file as text, or wrapped in `<script>`/`<style>`. |
| `store()` | `(name: string): T` | Reads the app's in-memory store. |
| `store()` | `(name: string, value: T): T` | Sets a value in the app's in-memory store; returns it. |
| `flash()` | `(): T \| undefined` | The one-time message set by `ctx.res.redirect(..., { flash })`, or `undefined`. |
| `pb()` | `(): any` | A PocketBase JS SDK client acting as the signed-in user (or a guest), in-process. |
| `httpError()` | `(status: number, message?: string): Error` | An error to throw: sends `status` with `message` (JSON from an endpoint, unless the request asks for HTML). |
| `error?` | `{ status: number; message: string }` | Set while `+error` renders. |
| `session` | `Session` | Needs the `auth` plugin in +config. |
| `realtime` | `Realtime` | Needs the `realtime` plugin in +config. |

### pages.HandlerResult

What a handler may return: a plain object is shallow-assigned into `ctx.data`.

```ts
type pages.HandlerResult = Partial<Data> | Response | void | undefined;
```

### pages.Handler

```ts
type pages.Handler = (ctx: Context) => HandlerResult | Promise<HandlerResult>;
```

### pages.Handlers

The exports of a route's `.ts` file: a page's code, or an endpoint (all optional).

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `load?` | `Handler` | Runs for every method, before the method's handler. |
| `get?` | `Handler` |  |
| `post?` | `Handler` |  |
| `put?` | `Handler` |  |
| `patch?` | `Handler` |  |
| `delete?` | `Handler` |  |

### pages.Middleware

A `+middleware.js` export. Call `next()` to continue and return its result.

```ts
type pages.Middleware = (ctx: Context, next: () => any) => any;
```

### pages.Plugin

What a JS plugin factory returns. Every hook is optional.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | Required and unique. |
| `extendContext()` | `(ctx: Context): void` | Adds to `ctx`, before any `onRequest`. |
| `onRequest()` | `(ctx: Context): void \| Promise<void>` | Before middleware. |
| `transform()` | `(e: { html: string; ctx: Context; file: string }): string` | After each page or layout renders (not partials); returns the new HTML. |

### pages.PluginFactory

A JS plugin: a factory that gets its entry's options from +config.

```ts
type pages.PluginFactory = (config: { [key: string]: any }) => Plugin;
```

### pages.Config

The export of `+config.js`.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `plugins?` | `(string \| PluginFactory \| ({ factory: PluginFactory } & { [option: string]: any }))[]` | Module names, built-in names (`auth`, `realtime`), factories, or `{ factory, ...options }`. |
| `debug?` | `boolean` | Detailed error pages and `ctx.log.debug` output outside dev mode. |

### pages.Props

The props pages passes to a JSX/TSX page, layout or partial it renders (an `include`'s locals typed by `L`). A
component you import and use as `<Card />` gets only the props you give it, so type those yourself.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `ctx` | `Context` |  |
| `data` | `Data` |  |
| `params` | `Params` |  |
| `meta` | `Context["meta"]` |  |
| `asset` | `Context["asset"]` |  |
| `include` | `Context["include"]` |  |
| `slot` | `{ (name?: string): any; (name: string, content: any): void }` | `slot(name)` reads a slot, `slot(name, content)` sets one, `slot()` is `children`. |
| `children?` | `any` | In a layout, the inner content. |
